english.note: Use this as the all-purpose choice when someone or something is physically in the midst of and surrounded by others.
This is the all-purpose spoken choice for something located in the middle of or surrounded by other things.

examples.english: I was standing among the crowd.
examples.jyutping: ngo5 kei5 zo2 hai2 jan4 kwan4 zung1 gaan1

examples.english: We sat amid trees in the middle of the park.
examples.traditional: 我哋坐喺公園中間，四圍都係樹。
examples.jyutping: ngo5 dei6 co5 hai2 gung1 jyun4 zung1 gaan1 sei3 wai4 dou1 hai6 syu6
